pick.name: Midjourney
pick.why: Best artistic quality and style control; no free tier.
pick.free_limits: No free plan; no trial on web or Discord (a limited trial exists only in the niji·journey mobile app). Basic $10/mo ($8 annual), Standard $30 ($24), Pro $60 ($48), Mega $120 ($96). Images are public unless on Pro/Mega (Stealth Mode). No public API
pick.license: Midjourney ToS: subscribers own outputs; businesses grossing over $1M/yr need Pro or Mega for commercial use

best_free.name: Nano Banana (Gemini image models)
best_free.what: Google Gemini native image generation and editing
best_free.why: Best for text rendering, edits and consistency; API about $0.034-0.24 per image; no free API image tier.
best_free.free_limits: Gemini app: Nano Banana 2 image generation is available without a paid plan (compute-based limits refreshing every 5 h up to a weekly cap). SynthID and C2PA are always embedded; a visible watermark is added by default, and an Aug 2026 Media Watermark setting reportedly lets users turn it off where not legally required (secondary sources). API has no free image tier: Nano Banana 2.1 $0.034/1K image up to Nano Banana Pro $0.24/4K. Gemini 2.5 Flash Image shut down 2 Oct 2026

alts.name: GPT Image (OpenAI)
alts.what: OpenAI image generation in ChatGPT and API
alts.why: Strong instruction following and text; pricing not verified.
alts.free_limits: ChatGPT Free includes 'limited image creation'; API pricing not re-verified

alts.name: FLUX (Black Forest Labs)
alts.why: Best open-weight/self-host route; API about $0.048 per image; commercial self-hosting needs a paid licence tier.
alts.free_limits: API pay-as-you-go; open-weight commercial licence tiers; separate non-commercial licence

candidates.name: Ideogram
candidates.verdict: free plan reportedly allows commercial use with public outputs; limits conflict across sources (unverified)

candidates.name: Recraft
candidates.verdict: best for vector/brand SVG; not re-verified

decision: Midjourney is the best overall for visual quality but needs a paid plan. For a free start, Gemini image generation covers most needs including text-in-image; Ideogram and Recraft are strong for typography and vector. Check each tool commercial and watermark terms before shipping.

verify.note: Prices and commercial terms are now confirmed from the official help centre. The pick is defensible for brand art only; the editor should weigh flipping it.

better.name: Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image) / GPT Image
better.reason: For founder work (text in images, product edits, consistent assets, API automation) these beat Midjourney's art-first, API-less, public-by-default model; Midjourney still leads on pure aesthetics.
